observations: Photo 0 shows the front right headlight assembly for a GLK (Golf L) from 2012.
The housing is clear plastic with a black rubber seal around the edge.
The lens is transparent with a central amber-colored section.
The housing appears to be in good cosmetic condition.
The item is resting on a blue metal surface with a brick background.

claims.evidence: The photo shows a 2012 model headlight, but the seller's text is unverified.
The photo shows only one headlight; a set typically means two units.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The photo may be a generic stock image or a low-quality digital copy.
risks.proof: A clear, high-resolution photo of the actual item being sold.

risks.risk: The headlight may be a generic aftermarket part rather than an original Toyota part.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's label or part number stamped on the housing.

risks.risk: The bulb may be missing or the housing may be cracked.
risks.proof: A photo of the bulb and the housing with the lens removed.
risks.if_unproven: as a bare housing with no bulb

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's part number stamped on the housing.
Photo of the bulb and the housing with the lens removed.
Photo of the other headlight in the set if it exists.
response.reason: The item is known from the photo. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
